title: CAMS-AI-12a: LLM provider abstraction + AI settings in DB
assumptions: AI_SETTINGS_SECRET is loaded from env and validated as 32-byte Fernet base64.
Database models include ai_providers, ai_settings, and ai_settings_audit.
Key masking exposes at most first 7 and last 4 characters separated by ellipses, or masked bullet points if short.
OpenAI-compatible client supports streaming SSE format over httpx.
Auto-seed creates default Google Gemini provider and settings if DB has no providers on startup.
